description_en: Retrieves a redirect URL for the low-code service by calling GetStandardRoomJumpUrl
description_zh: 调用GetStandardRoomJumpUrl获取低代码服务跳转链接
kebab_example: aliyun imp get-standard-room-jump-url --app-id 7m000q --user-id as0000hs --app-key 060009c --platform web --biz-type live --biz-id b7f2-0000-ebb3 --user-nick James --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetStandardRoomJumpUrl

parameters.help_en: The application ID of the user, generated when the application is created in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits, and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID, which is unique within the specified AppId. The value contains lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and periods (.). The maximum length is 32 characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户UserId，在AppId下单独唯一。小写英文、数字、下划线（_）和小数点（.）组成，最大长度32个字符
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The terminal device type, created and queried in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits, and is 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 终端设备类型，通过控制台创建和查询。小写英文和数字，长度32个字符
parameters.name: app_key

parameters.help_en:
The platform type for which to retrieve the URL. Valid values:

win: Windows.

web: Web.
mac: Mac
parameters.help_zh:
选择获取链接的平台类型。取值：

win：Windows端。

web： Web端。
mac：Mac端
parameters.name: platform

parameters.help_en:
The business scenario type. Valid values:

live: interactive live streaming.

class: interactive classroom
parameters.help_zh:
业务场景类型。取值：

live：互动直播。

class：互动课堂
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en:
The resource ID. The value varies by business scenario type:

For interactive live streaming, specify the live streaming ID (LiveId).
For interactive classroom, specify the class ID (ClassId)
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID。根据业务场景类型来定：

互动直播场景传入直播ID(LiveId)。
互动课堂场景传入课程ID(ClassId)
parameters.name: biz_id

parameters.help_en: The nickname displayed for the user. The value contains uppercase and lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), periods (.), and at signs (@). The length is 1 to 36 characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户用于显示的昵称，英文大小写字母、汉字、数字、下划线（_）、短横线（-）、小数点（.）和@组成。长度为1到36个字符
parameters.name: user_nick

Result.description_en: The response of the GetStandardRoomJumpUrl operation
Result.description_zh: 调用获取低代码服务跳转链接的接口返回结果

StandardRoomJumpUrl.description_en: The redirect URL for the low-code service
StandardRoomJumpUrl.description_zh: 低代码服务跳转协议地址
